Why Do Cuts Heal? Your Body's Tiny Super Bandage! — You scraped your knee on the sidewalk! But within minutes, an invisible superhero team starts rebuilding your skin!
Kids science answer for "how scrapes and cuts heal kids science" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When you scrape your knee, tiny blood cells called platelets rush in like a construction team, weaving a net of fibers that hardens into a protective scab.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
